title: Dead-end record lacks substantive analysis
detail: Approach, failure reason, and retry predicate must explain why the route failed and under what conditions it could be reopened.
fix_hint: Provide a substantive description of what was examined, why it failed, and a concrete retry predicate.

example.why_it_fails: Valuation bounds diverge at the critical boundary.
example.retry_predicate: Worth retrying if boundary conditions are tightened.
